title: Clean Itens
description: This data pack cleans up items in your world!
body:
# ClearDrops Countdown 45m

A simple, efficient, and extremely lightweight Data Pack developed specifically for **Minecraft 1.21.1**. It automatically clears dropped items from the world every 45 minutes, helping to keep your server's performance (TPS) stable and lag-free.

What sets this pack apart is its user-friendly notification system, ensuring that no player is caught off guard and loses important items without warning!

### ✨ Features

* **Fully Automatic:** Starts working as soon as the server launches or when you use the `/reload` command.
* **45-Minute Cycle:** Clears entities of type `item` every 2,700 seconds.
* **Color-Coded Alerts:** Sends automatic, colored messages to all players in the chat.
* **Full Compatibility:** Works on Vanilla, Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Quilt, or Paper servers (as long as they support data packs).

### 🔔 Notification Schedule

The pack uses a precise scheduling system to keep everyone informed:

1.  **5 Minutes Before:** `[Server] Ground items will be cleared in 5 minutes!` (Yellow)
2.  **2 Minutes Before:** `[Server] Ground items will be cleared in 2 minutes!` (Gold)
3.  **Final Countdown:** A 5-second red countdown in chat: `5...`, `4...`, `3...`, `2...`, `1...`
4.  **Cleanup Complete:** `[Server] The ground has been cleared successfully!` (Green)

### 🚀 How to Install

1.  Download the Data Pack `.zip` file.
2.  Navigate to your world folder (e.g., `/world/datapacks`).
3.  Place the `.zip` file inside the `datapacks` folder.
4.  Type `/reload` in-game or in the server console.
